features.description: Skill + framework-as-a-layer: the activity-authoring-assistant SKILL.md (teacher-only accessControl, capable model, starter teaching-framework = placeholder system prompt + structure-rubric framing as its instruction) + a TEACHING_FRAMEWORK registry constant (1.1.50 M0). Behind a teacher-tier dark flag.
acceptance_criteria: activity-authoring-assistant skill loads; accessControl.type == 'tagged' with role:teacher
the starter teaching-framework default + TEACHING_FRAMEWORK constant are present and injected as the agent instruction
behind a teacher-tier dark flag (manual builder unaffected, Axiom 5)

features.description: set_lesson_prompt authoring write-tool: owner-scoped FunctionTool that reads user:id from tool_context.state, loads the activity, denies if not owner (404), and returns a PROPOSAL (does NOT auto-persist). Wired into the skill's tools. Declarative-only (no code-gen).
acceptance_criteria: set_lesson_prompt rejects a non-owner (404/deny) and returns a well-formed proposal for the owner
the tool never persists directly (proposal only; teacher Applies on the FE)
tool registered in adk/tools.py and listed in the skill's metadata.tools; BE lint + test-fast green

features.description: Structure-rubric + eval scaffold: the 1.1.50 rubric as a checkable artefact (rubric lines as data) + an eval scaffold that scores a draft against the current framework version. AR owns the real scoring key.
acceptance_criteria: the structure rubric is well-formed (each line has id + a checkable description)
an eval scaffold runs and scores a fixture draft against the rubric (placeholder bar; AR sign-off pending)
the rubric is versioned with the framework (authoringFrameworkVersion stamp seam)

features.description: Teacher-auth chat panel + A2UI accept/edit card, modeled on _AnalyticsChat.tsx: <AGUIProvider skillId useTeacherAuth> in the builder behind the dark flag; proposal -> Apply/Edit/Dismiss card; Apply mutates teachingGoal via the shipped save path; builder fully usable with the assistant disabled. Browser-verify is the remaining gate.
acceptance_criteria: the chat panel mounts with useTeacherAuth (auth-corner regression guard: a group token is NOT minted)
the proposal card renders Apply/Edit/Dismiss; Apply mutates the draft and only then persists
the builder works fully with the assistant disabled (degradation)
FE npm run quality:check green; browser-verify flagged as the remaining gate
features.notes: Largest milestone; may carry to a follow-up session. Browser-verify (SSE stream + Apply round-trip) is the deferred gate.
